# Deploying billing-svc

Production settings are NOT here. Every environment value
(host, port, pool sizes) is read from config/prod.yaml at boot.
Staging mirrors production except where config/staging.yaml overrides.

host: billing.internal.example.com
port: 9443
pool:
  min: 4
  max: 32
tls: required
